method: direct byte inspection plus canonical source-provenance comparison
action: Null each proven-wrong active binding in specimens.json and SOURCES.json; retain immutable image bytes for history and later audit.

Comic-strip Phantom; not Lon Chaney's Phantom performance.
Bram Stoker book cover; not Gary Oldman's Dracula performance.
Astronomical Betelgeuse image; not Michael Keaton's character.
Korg keyboard; not Taika Waititi's Korg performance.
Frank Welker portrait; not Megatron or Scooby-Doo.
Generic Muppet Show title card; none of the filed characters is depicted.
Grave plot from a filename collision; not performer Tim Rose.
South Park sign graphic; no filed character performance is depicted.
RPG dice; not Hulk or a filed monster performance.
Looney Tunes logo; no filed character performance is depicted.
Historical John du Pont group photo; not Steve Carell's portrayal.
Live-action MCU Hawkeye frame; not Chris Cox's filed portrayal.

current_replay_boundary: The rejected hashes and rulings are durable. Current-main source bindings must be checked before mutation, then all projections must be rebuilt from current sources.
